description: Full evaluation default matrix: the twelve single-turn scenarios of hub-profile-candidate and five conversations (about 35 turns), on bundled ChartSearchAI and the Hub's single-12b-answer product profile (one answer call with deterministic checks, no review or In-Depth), both on the same 12B engine through the parity taps, so the arms differ by the Hub being in the loop and not by the Hub's model review. A checked profile is an added arm (PROFILES=).
